result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane urban crossing with high-visibility continental crosswalk markings and curb ramps. However, the lack of a pedestrian refuge island or visible traffic control signals on a four-lane roadway creates significant exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Multiple Threat Risk
hazards.description: The multi-lane configuration allows for a 'multiple threat' scenario where a vehicle in one lane stops for a pedestrian, but a vehicle in an adjacent lane does not, obscured by the first vehicle.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No visible signals or stop signs are present to regulate vehicle flow at this wide crossing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add user-actuated amber LEDs to increase driver yielding rates at the uncontrolled crossing.
